title: Home page: set selected key metrics to static values

requirements.summary: Set the selected Total P&L value <span> on HomePage to the exact static text "$17.5".
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Total P&L value <span> renders exactly "$17.5" as plain text.
The element remains a <span> and only this selected element’s content is changed.

file_operations.description: Change ONLY the existing Total P&L value <span> content (the <span> inside the Total P&L card) from its current text to the exact static string "$17.5" (including the $ sign), without adding any computed/fallback logic and keeping the element as a <span>.

requirements.summary: Set the selected Total Trades value container on HomePage to the exact static text "1".
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Total Trades value renders exactly "1" as plain text.
Only the selected element is changed; other cards/labels/layout remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Change ONLY the existing Total Trades value container content (the value container div in the Total Trades card) to render the exact static text "1" and remove any computed value / fallback expression, without changing the element type or affecting other metrics.

requirements.summary: Set the selected Winning Trades value container on HomePage to the exact static text "1".
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Winning Trades value renders exactly "1" as plain text.
Only the selected element is changed; other sections/cards remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Change ONLY the existing Winning Trades value container content (the value container div under the Winning Trades card) to render the exact static text "1" and remove any computed value / fallback expression, without changing the element type or affecting other sections.
